full_edge_case_matrix.policy: Critical/high cases require executable evidence or explicit accepted-risk disposition before hardened/production state.

accountability.rule: No tracked plan item may be represented as complete without validated checkbox, UTC timestamped implementation signoff, independent verification signoff, git revision and evidence.

build_depth_sequence.rule: Construction waves order and gate work; they do not replace AIQ dependencies, gap closure, vertical-slice evidence, or signed accountability.

specified.meaning: scope and canonical identity are defined; implementation may not exist

scaffolded.meaning: requirements and intended capability/contract shape are explicit enough to build

implemented.meaning: code/config exists behind declared contracts with focused tests

integrated.meaning: implementation participates in assembled runtime with integration evidence

hardened.meaning: failure, security, recovery and mapped high-impact edge obligations are closed or explicitly accepted

production.meaning: release/rollback/operations/SLO evidence exists and signed accountability is complete

experimental.meaning: bounded research candidate; must not be treated as production authority

retired.meaning: removed from active production authority with retained lineage/evidence

volume_maturity_policy.promotion_rule: Status promotion is invalid unless all fields required by the target maturity state are non-empty and signed accountability permits the corresponding implementation_status.
volume_maturity_policy.anti_shortcut: File existence, LOC, a passing happy path, or documentation alone cannot satisfy a maturity promotion.

engineering_pass.scope: Depth-only systems-engineering obligations for W00-W30; no new top-level architecture.
engineering_pass.closure_rule: Applicable interface, invariant, failure/recovery, budget, compatibility, observability, reproducibility and release obligations require concrete evidence before strong maturity claims.
engineering_pass.task_propagation_rule: Every AIQ task inherits engineering obligations from all work_package_refs; task done state cannot substitute for strong capability promotion evidence.

adversarial_closure.scope: Depth-only cross-condition and compound-fault closure for W00-W30; Volume 420 breadth freeze preserved.
adversarial_closure.closure_rule: Strong maturity claims require applicable adversarial axes, pairwise interaction coverage, compound campaigns, replayable recovery, and independent artifact-bound evidence.

execution_frontier.promotion_rule: merged implementation is candidate evidence; signed accountability lifecycle state changes only after exact-head acceptance evidence and independent verification

enterprise_grade_policy.rule: All volumes inherit the enterprise common contract. Dedicated-profile volumes cannot be called enterprise-qualified or superior until their exact-head profile and non-compensable gates pass.
enterprise_grade_policy.anti_shortcut: Implementation status, LOC, a green happy-path test, documentation, or self-scored evaluation cannot satisfy enterprise qualification.
enterprise_grade_policy.required_for_product_claim: A complete enterprise AI claim requires all VOL-000..VOL-420 to be enterprise_qualified on current evidence; dedicated critical profiles must additionally reach superior.
enterprise_grade_policy.implementation_dossier_rule: Every VOL-000..VOL-420 must carry a current 14-level October 2026 implementation dossier; enterprise qualification is invalid when dossier/masterplan drift exists.

competitive_engineering_ladder.scope: overlay-only; binds to existing VOL-000..VOL-420 ownership
competitive_engineering_ladder.completion_rule: Exact-head implementation, tests, adversarial evidence and exit criteria are required; prose alone never completes a level.
competitive_engineering_ladder.superiority_rule: Each family level 10 requires Pareto-safe reproducible comparator evidence and independent promotion authority.

ai_game_builder_500_levels.prime_directive: Long-form consistency may veto any local improvement.
ai_game_builder_500_levels.completion_rule: Exact-head implementation plus deterministic/adversarial/recovery/rights evidence is required; prose, round count, elapsed time or model confidence never completes a level.
ai_game_builder_500_levels.originality_rule: Unknown incorporated rights are quarantined; reference-only sources may inform facts, techniques and abstract ideas but may not supply protected expression; ambiguous legal/similarity cases require human/legal review.

laws: overlays are cumulative unless an explicit supersession record names the retired authority
reconciliation may not lower plan_version
reconciliation may not delete a live registered overlay
reconciliation may not replace a non-empty live authority with an empty blob
reconciliation may not remove the sole validator, test or workflow for a live overlay
incoming overlays are unioned with current-main authority rather than reconstructed from a stale ancestor
registered overlays must preserve declared semantic cardinality and topology, not merely file presence or JSON validity
